key_insight: SOTA turns option trading into structured strategy selection, using an agent to choose the strategy while deterministic rules build the actual options portfolio.
engineering_relevance: The framework reduces the complexity of trading thousands of option contracts by making the decision space strategy-level, which is useful for practical AI-assisted portfolio systems.
method: Post-trains Qwen3.8-27B with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.
Abstracts the option universe into strategy decisions, with deterministic resolvers executing the final trades.
Uses option-implied return distributions and news context to guide policy learning and action selection.
evidence_signal: On a six-month out-of-sample test across options on nine large-cap U.S. equities plus SPY, SOTA achieved 18.3% total return, a 1.60 Sharpe ratio, and 8.96% maximum drawdown.
watch_item: Retaining news during reinforcement learning caused performance to drop sharply out of sample, suggesting sensitivity to information leakage or train-test mismatch in the news pipeline.
paper_title: SOTA: Stock Options Trading Agents Guided by Option-Implied Return Distributions
